Is this command expected to grow flags for every container field? in the past we've decided against this approach (e.g. in `kubectl create $type` since specifying structured information via flags quickly gets unwieldy. I completely understand your concern, and Jordan's. However, I am approaching this from a pragmatic side. kubectl debug is completely useless to me without SYS_PTRACE capability, so any solution that will finally allow me to properly debug distroless containers will be fine. issue_context.title: [enhancement] kubectl alpha debug add SYS_PTRACE for debug container
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->
```
VERSION: v1.18.3
Command:  kubectl alpha debug -it xxx-854d568b99-klgc9 --image=myimage:latest --container=xxx-854d568b99-klgc9 --target=xxx
In Debug Container: I use PTRACE for my process , but I get error message: 
Failed to setns 4: Operation not permitted
```
**What would you like to be added**:
I hope that this debug feature can add "SYS_PTRACE" for container

**Why is this needed**:
We always to analysis  our process in POD , this PTRACE is very useful

EDIT: CORRECTION 
kubectl debug --profile=netadmin is available since kubectl 1.27.0  as far as I can see.
Related pull request: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/114280
Using `kubectl debug` with `--profile=general` will add `SYS_PTRACE` permission. See https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-cli/1441-kubectl-debug#debugging-profiles
